evidenceBoundaries: The three client-to-Direct candidates match within 27ms using client-supplied occurred_at and server journal time; platform/version agrees, but no client request/trace key connects them exactly.
All client received_at timestamps also precede all three backend cutovers, so this timing conclusion does not depend solely on the client clock.

All three Direct400 anonymous request keys exactly match R133 structured complete_audio_failed and request_failed status400 events. Their ValueError frame at pinned tts_service.py generate_audio line595 identifies the no_speakable_content branch; these three 400s originated in the upstream model, not Direct local input validation.

The model branch establishes that generation returned no audio and the existing requires-generated-audio guard was false. It does not reveal the original text, prove punctuation-only input, or establish per-request language/voice/textChars.

The 16MiB ordinary combined-log tail starts at 16:13:12.943049 UTC and covers only the third requested window. The first two windows have no ordinary log metadata. Third-window one-second logs have no request ID/PID and interleave different text lengths and language routes; adjacent textChars=1/language/voice rows are unjoined context, not per-request evidence.

Old Direct logs do not record the 400 response body, error code, abort source/stage or downstream disconnection state. Model correlation establishes the generation layer but does not fill these unavailable gateway fields. These 400s do not prove timeout, cancellation or user intent.
A first-audio event and later failure can occur in the same reading session; first audio is not a successful-playback completion metric.

US incident diagnosis uses only the existing three +/-2-second model window artifact and pinned static source. A separately authorized CN static source/process read confirms identical service/router SHA-256 and the same branch, but no CN failure events or synthesis were queried.

resolvedFindings: Broad Unicode punctuation classification replaced with explicit silent-separator allowlist to preserve readable/unknown symbols.
Silent event renamed silent_request_audio_ready with encoded flag; it is not an HTTP-success event.
Opus final muxer page is read after container close; other codecs retain prior streaming order.
candidateCodeReview.recoveryBenefit: Known sentence/wrapping separators and whitespace produce one complete bounded 100ms silent asset; middle separator-only units do not fail the surrounding readable generation.
candidateCodeReview.gatewayCompatibility: Global requires nonempty audio but does not require timestamps; complete processed_text with explicit empty unprocessed_text passes both Direct and Global.

verification.covers: Six codecs, stream omitted/true/false, two silent inputs; normal full/streaming PCM/WAV/MP3/Opus, readable-symbol failure behavior, middle-unit continuation and final encoder bytes.
verification.independentChecks: Actual allowlist AST excludes readable/unknown fixtures; exact evidence joins, source hashes and ordinary-log coverage checked.

candidateCodeReview.historicalInputLimitation: Original text was not queried; old no-speakable-content guard false is broader than the new conservative silent allowlist. Cannot claim all three historical requests are reproduced or guaranteed recovered.

cnReleaseAssessment.existingCandidateCapability: Loopback temporary canary, not a routable standby slot; requires fresh capacity/identity evidence.
cnReleaseAssessment.existingCutoverCapability: Atomic current symlink plus exact-process SIGTERM, up to180s graceful drain, watchdog starts replacement on8880.
cnReleaseAssessment.specificAvailabilityLimit: Uvicorn stops accepting new requests while draining and during replacement model startup. Existing active requests may finish, but new synthesis cannot be handed to another serving slot.
cnReleaseAssessment.legacyToolsFixedTargets: Existing r131 operator/host pins r130 to r131b; cannot directly deploy a new release.
cnReleaseAssessment.decision: Keep CN unchanged this round; complete US path with observed faults. CN shared static risk and release limitation remain explicit; no broad CN incident scan.
